title: std::student_t_distribution<RealType>::n
summary: Returns the n distribution parameter (number of the degrees of freedom) the distribution was constructed with. The default value is 1.0.
html:
RealType n() const;
 (since C++11)

Returns the n distribution parameter (number of the degrees of freedom) the distribution was constructed with. The default value is 1.0.

Parameters

(none)

Return value

Floating point value identifying the degrees of freedom of the distribution.
